newsitem.title: JAPAN: Denso up amid car share popularity.
newsitem.headline: Denso up amid car share popularity.

text.p: Shares in Denso Corp were higher in early afternoon trade on Tuesday, towed by popularity of automobile shares due to a weakening yen against the dollar, brokers said.
At 0442 GMT, the shares were 20 yen higher at 2,510, after rising as high as 2,530 yen. Turnover was 457,000 shares.
The top producer of electrical car parts for automobiles changed its name to Denso Corp from Nippondenso Co Ltd on Tuesday. It is a member of the Toyota group.
Toyota Motor Corp shares set a new yearly high of 2,880 yen earlier in the day.
